scenes.speaker: Class Group
lines: A late-night ping in your batch group: someone drops a clip of contraband vapes.
"Whoever is brave enough to test this tomorrow at the back bench, reply with a fire emoji!"

choices.text: Ignore the group chat and mute notifications for the night.
choices.feedback: Digital boundaries protect your peace. Not reacting denies them the audience they seek.

choices.text: Reply: "Not worth getting suspended before semester exams, folks."
choices.feedback: Outstanding leadership! A reality check often encourages silent classmates to stay safe too.

choices.text: Drop a laughing emoji to blend in.
choices.feedback: Even passive approval can escalate risky peer challenges. Quiet firmness is healthier.

scenes.speaker: Next Morning
lines: At college the next day, two peers whisper that they also didn't want to get involved.
Your stance gave others the quiet courage to back away.
